text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as we get back from our day out…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My phone's ringing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hello, this is Air Groove. Yes? Mm-hm… Okay.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that right? You found a home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The call was from the animal protection group. They've found a family to take in the puppy Air Groove has been temporarily housing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Apparently, they'll come to the academy tomorrow to pick her up.
choice_data_list: It's gonna be lonely with her gone.
It's gonna be lonely with her gone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey now. You know how observant she is—if you make that dejected expression, she'll be able to tell.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This arrangement was never meant to last. If you plan to come along tonorrow, you'd better see her off with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day arrives in the blink of an eye, and it's time for our final goodbyes.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a lovely coat! I can tell you've really looked after her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I merely did what anyone would have.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Don't be so modest! Air Groove has taught her all the basic commands.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: She's especially good at fetch!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's enough, Fine.

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's a relief knowing that she was in such capable hands.

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to take good care of her from here on out! C'mere, you cutie!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof! Whine…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! She's heading over to Groove…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, now! You know better than to ignore a command!

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come on, you know this. When your new owner says "come," you go. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The puppy turns away from Air Groove and heads to her new owner.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Groove…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay with this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's question catches me off guard. I turn to the new owner.
choice_data_list: Can we spend just a little more time with her?
Have you decided on a name?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's gotten into you?

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: Of course! I think it would be good for the puppy too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, if it's good for her…
choice_data_list: You can't hide how you really feel.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, now…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haha… You really are a clever little thing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's let them have some time alone.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No eating random things off the street, okay? Drink lots of water. Don't nap anywhere silly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Also…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Agh, there's just too much I want to say.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Allowing herself to be honest with her feelings for the time being, Air Groove makes the most of her final moments with the puppy.

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: A name? No, not yet. I wanted to meet her first.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: I know. Why don't you name her, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: M-me? Heavens no!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's a great idea! You know her better than anyone, after all. How about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-hold on! A name is for life! How could I—

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: Please. For her sake.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Nngh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove stares at the puppy in silence for a little while. Finally, she opens her mouth and mutters…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Perhaps we can call you… "Maple."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Maple? Hm… Makes me think of a life filled with bright colors and all kinds of joy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What a thoughtful name, Groove. I should've known you wouldn't accept anything short of perfect!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I hope it's fitting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I wish you all the best, Maple.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove smiles at the puppy—and her little friend excitedly barks back.

text_block_list.name: New Owner
text_block_list.text: Of course! I actually live kind of close to here. I've heard the park near the academy is a good place for walking dogs!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh… Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then you won't be too far from each other! That's good to hear. Right, Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm… Perhaps, but I thought it might be best for her to forget about me.

text_block_list.name: Puppy
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Looks like that won't be happening anytime soon. As you said, she's quite smart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh…
choice_data_list: How about we jog at that park sometime?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Nobody asked for your opinion!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Maybe once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her cool exterior, Air Groove asks me to change our running course.
